# J1 federal source list. Format: id|url
#
# Authored literals only. This file is reviewed and merged by Dean; nothing here
# is ever fetched from elsewhere. Machine interfaces only — the HTML sites
# (congress.gov, veterans.house.gov, DFAS.mil, eCFR, esd.whs.mil, ftb.ca.gov)
# are bot-walled and stay structurally dark to CI. See design section C.
#
# eCFR appears on that walled list as an HTML FRONT END. Its api/versioner
# surface is a different thing and is reachable — that distinction is the
# section C.6 "agency machine interface" pattern, and it is why
# ecfr-title-versioner can be enrolled below while eCFR stays walled above.
#
# One source per line. Adding a source is a one-line diff, which is the point:
# the sweep must be able to say "this source changed" mechanically.
#
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.

federal-register-va|https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?conditions[agencies][]=veterans-affairs-department&per_page=20&order=newest
federal-register-dod|https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?conditions[agencies][]=defense-department&per_page=20&order=newest

# TIER 1, enrolled 5 AUG 2026 per the Coverage Charter (design section 0.7).
# Each re-fetched live immediately before this line was written; status,
# content type, and newest-item date recorded in section 0.7.1. A URL verified
# three days ago is not a URL verified today.
federal-register-opm|https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?conditions[agencies][]=personnel-management-office&per_page=20&order=newest
# SLUG WARNING: it is veterans-employment-and-training-service. The general
# employment-and-training-administration slug was tested and REJECTED - 10,000
# documents of H-2A wage rules and Job Corps with near-zero veteran content.
federal-register-dolvets|https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?conditions[agencies][]=veterans-employment-and-training-service&per_page=20&order=newest
# Trip-wire, not a content feed: reports THAT a CFR title changed, never what.
# This is the ecfr.gov API, which is a different surface from the bot-walled
# eCFR HTML front end named above.
ecfr-title-versioner|https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/titles.json
